claims.assertion: Anéeka says Andromedans lead the Federation locally and notify each ship electronically in its language; attendance at meetings is optional.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes fitted smart suits that regulate temperature, stiffen on impact, protect against kinetic or energy weapons, and carry biometric telemetry.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says these are also used as spacesuits.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says capes mark high responsibility at public Federation events; white indicates royalty, followed by violet.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says other cape colors have no consistent meaning.
